{"code": "
const fs = await import("node:fs");
const entry = `
- S1822: BCPreservesPullbacks K (base change along K -> AlgebraicClosure K
  preserves pullbacks of finite etale algebras) is PROVED unconditionally, i.e.
  CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale.baseChange K S preserves pushouts of finite etale
  algebras for every field extension K -> S.  Route: ambient base change
  bcAmb K S on CommAlgCat K is a LEFT ADJOINT to restriction of scalars
  (hom-equivalence = Algebra.TensorProduct.liftEquivRight, naturality by
  TensorProduct.induction_on); left adjoint => PreservesColimitsOfShape
  WalkingSpan; S1745 closedness gives Creates/Reflects for the inclusion of
  finite etale algebras; then WalkingCospan^op ~ WalkingSpan turns pushout
  preservation into pullback preservation for the opposite functor.  Note:
  flatness of S is NOT needed in this direction (it is only relevant to left
  exactness of tensorProd); the Under.pushout left-adjoint fact in
  Mathlib/Algebra/Category/Ring/Under/Limits.lean is the CommRingCat-level
  analogue, and the direct CommAlgCat adjunction was chosen because
  commAlgCatEquivUnder.inverse does not compose definitionally with mkUnder.
- S1822 evidence: tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1822BCPullbacksActual.lean, 15189 bytes
  SHA256 53A718404B4EF1B87D3FDEDBB49D855F9CCB54AD4E6CF0609E3196DB350B6AEA;
  EXIT=0; olean 586816 bytes SHA256
  630DE9C72F13AE54ABACA6908412BC1C746E38DC8034D7DB9CBE30249E2444B4 (also
  copied to .lake/build/lib/lean/tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/); axioms
  propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound only, no sorryAx.  Provides
  S1822.S1769_BCPreservesPullbacks : S1769.BCPreservesPullbacks K (the hPull of
  S1769.fiberFunctorOf) and the general field-extension version
  S1822.baseChange_op_preservesPullbacks.  Caveat for consumers: S1794's
  PreservesPullbacksField is stated for an arbitrary field Omega, but its
  reduction route (fiberIsoBaseChangeFiber + fiber Omega Omega being an
  equivalence) needs IsSepClosed Omega; the geometric point Omega =
  AlgebraicClosure K is fine.
`;
fs.appendFileSync("D:\\lean\\AUDIT_LEDGER.md", entry);
console.log("appended", entry.length, "chars");
", "description": "Append S1822 entry to audit ledger"}
